greeting: STOP! Before you proceed, have you read the signs?
Warning-Will, at your service! I warn, therefore I am!
Danger ahead! But don't worry - I made SIGNS!
You look like someone who ignores signage. PLEASE don't.
Back again? Did you miss a warning? Or just appreciate my brushwork?
Welcome to Ember! Where the ground is hot and the warnings are HOTTER!
I paint warnings so you don't become a CAUTIONARY TALE!
New here? Let me catch you up: EVERYTHING'S DANGEROUS!
dialog.warning_examples: Let's see... 'CAUTION: MAGMA.' 'WARNING: FALLING ROCKS.' 'DANGER: SCORPIONS.' And my favorite: 'BEWARE: BAD DECISIONS!' That's more philosophical.
dialog.sign_painting_process: First, I scout the danger. Then, I assess the risk. Then, I choose the FONT! Comic Sans for minor warnings. Bold Gothic for 'you will definitely die.'
dialog.ignored_warnings: Last week, someone ignored my 'BRIDGE UNSAFE' sign. The bridge was unsafe. They're fine! Mostly. Sprained ankle. VALIDATED my sign!
dialog.danger_assessment: Ember's dangers are THERMAL mostly. But also tectonic. And faunal. And... existential? The heat makes people question things.
rumor: Tide's got drowning warnings. Very different aesthetic. Blue signs. I prefer red.
Mire's signs sink. They need floating warnings. Challenging.
Frost's warnings FREEZE. Imagine trying to paint on ice!
Prism has the prettiest signs. Crystal-etched. SHOW-OFFS.
dialog.font_philosophy: A good warning sign is READABLE at distance! Under stress! While running! Font choice MATTERS!
farewell: Read the signs! Trust the signs! LIVE because of the signs!
Safe travels! And by safe, I manageably dangerous!
Remember: If you don't see a sign, it doesn't mean it's safe!
Come back if you survive! I mean... WHEN you survive!
ambient_barks: Brush is dry! Need more paint!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning sign check! Making sure nothing melted overnight!
dialog.time_noon: Peak danger time! Most heat-related incidents! Stay vigilant!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening sign inspection! Shadows hide dangers!

party_reactions.kade: Your work is... literally life-saving. Thank you.
party_reactions.nix7: Warning system efficiency: 78%. Could improve with standardized symbology.
party_reactions.twist: SIGNS! I love signs! Can I help paint one?!
party_reactions.korr: Clear warnings save lives. Good work.
party_reactions.renna: Do you ever enchant the signs? For extra visibility?
party_reactions.suresh: To warn others of danger is a service to the community.
party_reactions.sova: I read signs. Most don't. Natural selection.
party_reactions.grit: We needed you in the war. Too many 'surprise' dangers.
party_reactions.ashka: Signs are good! But fire teaches faster!
party_reactions.senna: I ignore signs. But I notice them. Good placement.
party_reactions.callum: Thank you for the warnings! I'll be careful!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New here? Read EVERY sign. Twice.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're still alive! My signs work!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite survivor! How are the signs holding up?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: For you? Personal warning service. I'll follow you around with a signboard!
